text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, we give a computer training data that includes both examples and correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it creates on its own. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The goal is to get good accuracy, which means the predictions are correct most of the time. The more good training data we provide, the better the model usually becomes at its job.
